preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the string t is between 1 and the length of s.
The maximum number of pieces Leha can glue is between 1 and 30.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if Leha can glue the pieces to match the souvenir, or 'NO' if he cannot.
